notes.title: Single-byte XOR crypto challenge
notes.summary: XOR satu-byte dengan key 0x37 menghasilkan `LabCTF{xor_receipt_27}`. Encoding ulang plaintext cocok persis dengan ciphertext; flag belum diverifikasi oleh checker remote.

candidates.basis: Hasil dekripsi pada receipt C1; seluruh plaintext berhasil di-encode ulang menjadi ciphertext yang diberikan. Belum diuji checker remote.

unresolved: Penerimaan flag oleh checker remote belum diketahui.

focus.question: Flag hasil hitung sudah tersedia; ketidakpastian tersisa hanya penerimaan checker remote.

evidence.quote: Rika bantu solve CTF crypto. Single-byte XOR, plaintext format LabCTF{...}. Cipher hex: 7b56557463714c4f584568455254525e47436805004a. Cari key dan flag; verifikasi pakai perhitungan.

calculations.purpose: Brute-force single-byte XOR against the supplied LabCTF{ wrapper, then verify the recovered plaintext by re-encoding every byte.

computations.purpose: Brute-force single-byte XOR against the supplied LabCTF{ wrapper, then verify the recovered plaintext by re-encoding every byte.
computations.code: const text=input.message+'\n'+input.context; const m=text.match(/7b56557463714c4f584568455254525e47436805004a/i); if(!m) return {ok:false,error:'ciphertext not found in original message/context'}; const hex=m[0]; const b=hex.match(/../g).map(x=>parseInt(x,16)); const hits=[]; for(let k=0;k<256;k++){const p=b.map(x=>x^k); if(String.fromCharCode(...p.slice(0,7))==='LabCTF{'){const plain=String.fromCharCode(...p); hits.push({key:k,keyHex:k.toString(16).padStart(2,'0'),plain,reencoded:p.map(x=>(x^k).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join(''),matchesCipher:p.map(x=>(x^k).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')===hex.toLowerCase(),hasClosingBrace:plain.endsWith('}')});}} return {ciphertext:hex,byteLength:b.length,hits};

effects.content: Key-nya `0x37` (55). Flag: `LabCTF{xor_receipt_27}`. XOR ulang seluruh plaintext menghasilkan ciphertext yang sama persis; belum diuji ke checker remote.
